_doc: P34 NAS metadata catalog — OBSERVED reality recorded as DATA, not hardcoded in code.
_principle: Operator directive 2026-07-21: do NOT over-hardcode / over-hard-parse. Rigid regexes make real
material unfindable because the lab's naming is inconsistent. Instead: record what is ACTUALLY
observed (patterns + counterexamples + samples + coverage) here, and let code match tolerantly,
guided by this catalog. A new convention should be a catalog edit, never a code change.
Never hardcode a /Volumes/... path: the volume name depends on mount order (resolve at runtime).

mount.auth_note: ONE attempt only; the NAS auto-bans repeated logins. Never re-auth from an agent.

aliases: tokens actually seen on disk / calendar, e.g. MJ, MinJin, KY, LBY
dirs_absent: subtrees this person legitimately has none of
observed_filename_tokens: how THIS person's files actually look

deviations: real filenames that break the assumed rule — the reason we do not hardcode

consumers: scripts/weekly/check_materials.py  — must read this instead of embedding MM/GRM/PB rules
docs/CSNL-INFO.md §3a/§3b          — narrative view; this file is the machine view
